name: Sweden: Boverket's building regulations (BFS 2024:8 hygiene and health, BFS 2024:9 safety in use)

review.note: Sweden's new rules are functional: they set no riser, going, stair width, handrail height, ceiling height, window or openable ratio (daylight is a daylight factor of 1.0 %, ventilation 0.35 l/s per m²), so only stair headroom is checked.
